title: Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan Term-End Schedule: Reminders, Follow-On Plans and Rent after the Term
content:
As the term of a Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan draws to a close, the plan fixes when the tenant is reminded, whether and from when a follow-on plan may be bought and what rent it locks, the rent charged once the term is over, and whether a rate increase may take effect right after the term.

| Plan | Reminder sent (calendar days before term end) | Follow-on plan may be bought | Follow-on plan may be bought from (calendar days before term end) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 3-Month Plan | 21 | Yes | 30 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 6-Month Plan | 30 | Yes | 30 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 9-Month Plan | 30 | Yes | 45 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 12-Month Plan | 45 | Yes | 60 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 18-Month Plan | 45 | Yes | 60 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 24-Month Plan | 60 | Yes | 60 |

Under all six plans:

- a follow-on plan locks the rent in effect on the follow-on plan's own term start date, not the rent locked by the plan it follows;
- the rent charged after the term ends is the covered agreement's monthly rent;
- a rate increase may be noticed to take effect right after the term.

## Worked dates (hypothetical term end)

Take a term that ends on 30 June.

| Plan | Reminder date | Earliest day a follow-on plan may be bought |
|---|---|---|
| 3-Month | 9 June (21 days before) | 31 May (30 days before) |
| 6-Month | 31 May (30 days before) | 31 May (30 days before) |
| 9-Month | 31 May (30 days before) | 16 May (45 days before) |
| 12-Month | 16 May (45 days before) | 1 May (60 days before) |
| 18-Month | 16 May (45 days before) | 1 May (60 days before) |
| 24-Month | 1 May (60 days before) | 1 May (60 days before) |
